summary:
益華電腦上一季 EPS 超預期4.1%，營收1.44億美元，EDA 訂閱動能延續。
• EPS 1.99 美元，較預估1.91超出4.07%。
• 營收1.44億美元（B級），規模穩健。
• 晶片複雜度提升持續推升 EDA 工具需求。
• 本益比93.04，市場給予高成長溢價。
ai_view:
訊號偏正面：EPS 連續超預期，反映 EDA 工具的剛性需求與訂閱模式的穩定性。本季營收年增率未揭露，但結合下一季的高成長，動能延續性佳。短期股價由 AI 與半導體設計主題驅動，中期看 Cadence 在 AI 驅動設計自動化的領先。追蹤指標：訂單背書、營收年增、AI 相關工具滲透與毛利率。93倍本益比下，需持續高成長才能支撐估值。

需留意：營收年增率未提供，成長趨勢需後續確認。；極高估值放大獲利不及預期的下檔風險。；半導體景氣與地緣政策變數。

summary_en:
Cadence beat EPS by 4.1% with $1.44B revenue, sustaining EDA subscription momentum.
• EPS of $1.99 beat the $1.91 estimate by 4.07%.
• Revenue of $1.44B held a solid scale.
• Rising chip complexity keeps driving EDA tool demand.
• P/E of 93.04 reflects a high-growth premium.

ai_view_en:
Signal is positive: consecutive EPS beats reflect inelastic EDA demand and subscription stability. Revenue YoY was undisclosed, but with the following quarter's strong growth, momentum looks durable. Near-term the stock is driven by AI and semiconductor-design themes; mid-term watch Cadence's lead in AI-driven design automation. Track backlog, revenue growth, AI-tool penetration, and gross margin. At 93x, sustained high growth is required to justify the valuation.

Watch：Revenue YoY was not provided, requiring later confirmation.; A very high valuation amplifies downside if earnings disappoint.; Semiconductor cycle and geopolitical policy are swing factors.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出4.07%，獲利穩定優於共識。
